name: Basewright: Plan
description: Produce the artifact: every path, package, account and sized parameter, each with the rule that produced it. Changes nothing. The plan is kept in the store under its own id, and the id is the last line of the log -- it is what the Apply template takes.

survey_vars.name: basewright_hosts
survey_vars.title: Host
survey_vars.description: The host to plan for, as the inventory names it.

survey_vars.name: basewright_engine_name
survey_vars.title: Engine
survey_vars.description: Which database engine is being provisioned. The values are the directories under profiles/.

survey_vars.name: basewright_version
survey_vars.title: Engine version
survey_vars.description: Leave empty to take the profile's default.

survey_vars.name: basewright_instance
survey_vars.title: Instance name
survey_vars.description: Leave empty to take the profile's default. Names the cluster, its paths and its unit.

survey_vars.name: basewright_environment
survey_vars.title: Environment
survey_vars.description: Recorded in the plan. Nothing gates on it yet, and the strictest of the plausible answers is the safest thing to assume.
